seo.title: AI automation for your business — stop re-typing, start reviewing
seo.description: Automate invoices, orders, reports and customer requests with AI and integrations. Measured on your own data, with human review where it matters.

hero.title: Your team should not be re-typing data.
hero.lead: We automate the repetitive work between your tools — invoices, orders, reports, customer requests — using integrations and AI, with a person reviewing anything uncertain.
bullets: Free automation audit of one process
Tested on your real documents before rollout
Works with French, Arabic and English documents
hero.whatsappMessage: Hello Atlaxys, I would like to automate a process in my business.

problem.title: Where the hours go
points: Invoices and receipts typed into accounting software by hand
Orders arriving on WhatsApp and email, copied into spreadsheets
Weekly reports assembled manually from several tools
Errors discovered weeks later, when they cost more to fix

solution.title: Automation with guardrails
solution.text: We connect your tools, add AI where the input is unstructured, and keep people in control with review queues and logs.

points.title: Document extraction
points.text: Invoices, receipts, forms and scans turned into validated data.

points.title: Request routing
points.text: Messages classified and sent to the right person with context.

points.title: Automatic reports
points.text: Figures pulled from every tool into one report, on schedule.

points.title: Integrations
points.text: Your CRM, ERP, accounting and messaging tools talking to each other.

items.title: Measured, not promised
items.text: We measure accuracy on a sample of your own documents before switching anything on.

items.title: People stay in control
items.text: Anything below the confidence threshold goes to a human review queue.

items.title: Your data stays protected
items.text: A privacy-first setup, designed with data-protection rules in mind.

proof.title: See the approach
proof.text: An illustrative example of how we design a document-automation pipeline:

steps.title: Tell us the process
steps.text: Which task eats the most time? Two minutes in the form.

steps.title: Free audit call
steps.text: We map the process and estimate the time you could save.

steps.title: Pilot
steps.text: One process automated and measured on your real data.

steps.title: Scale
steps.text: Extend to the next process once the first one proves itself.

items.question: Do we need to change our software?
items.answer: Usually not. We connect to the tools you already use through their APIs, exports or email.

items.question: Is AI accurate enough?
items.answer: For many document types, yes — but we prove it on your data first, and keep human review for uncertain cases.

items.question: Is our data used to train AI?
items.answer: No. We configure providers so your data is not used for training, and document how data is handled.
